caption: The drawing depicts a scene featuring a horse-drawn cart with a driver and another figure beside the cart. The horse is colored brown and is harnessed to a yellow cart with large red and yellow wheels. The driver sitting in the cart is wearing a light blue long-sleeved shirt, dark trousers, and a white hat with a blue band. The driver and the other figure, who stands to the right near some large green leaves, both have dark skin and exaggerated facial features. The standing figure is wearing a red shirt and blue pants. The base of the drawing is green with a pattern resembling grass or foliage. The objects are rendered with careful shading and attention to detail. The artist's signature, “Bertha Samuels,” appears at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Cast Iron Toy Bank
